setvars.name: vis_TS
setvars.meaning: hubcaps versus bare wheels; value for hubcaps is 1 on GX217, GX317 C8 2D and C8 3D, but 0 on GX117L, C8G 3D, GPL, MG2/MG3, MI and GX417 (bare wheel is the opposite value)

setvars.name: cache_lum
setvars.meaning: covers on roof lights: 0 trim, 1 bare light; GX317 C8 3D only

setvars.name: ver_clim
setvars.meaning: 1 Eberspacher roof A/C (removes rear roof hatch), 0 none; GX317 C8 3D

setvars.name: ver_sieges
setvars.meaning: seat make and layout, also moves grab poles and stop buttons; values per model: C8 2D/3D Pino=0, Pino alt layout=10, B3000=1; MIDR 2D B3000=0, alt=10, circular alt=100; MIDR 3D Chardon=0, RVI 18B=1, RVI=2, B3000=3, Ciclo=4; GX417 B3000=0, RVI=1, RVI alt=10, RVI 18B=2

setvars.name: ver_sieges_av
setvars.meaning: front seat shape: 0 wide, 1 narrow; GX317 MIDR 3D

setvars.name: ver_body
setvars.meaning: restyling phase: MIDR 3D 0 Euro1 body, 1 Euro2 body, 2 Euro2 coach style with extra tank; GX417 0 Mark 1, 1 Mark 2

setvars.name: ver_cloison
setvars.meaning: metal trim on engine bulkhead plus plinth in floor material

setvars.name: ver_logos
setvars.meaning: GX417 front signs: 0 Heuliez only, 1 Volvo only, 2 Heuliez+Volvo+GX417, 3 GX417 only (rear signs follow ver_body)

setvars.name: sv_display_front
setvars.meaning: front destination display model; 2 and 3 disable front ext cover setvar; 5 gives a terminal note; PRO replaces 2 and 3 with 0

setvars.name: sv_display_front_extCover
setvars.meaning: 0 black mask around front display on, 1 off

setvars.name: sv_display_front_intCover
setvars.meaning: 0 metal cover on, 1 off; not available on PRO (always on); off disables front interior display

setvars.name: sv_display_side_L
setvars.meaning: left side display off/on; not on 10 m vehicles

setvars.name: sv_passenger_seatcovers_req
setvars.meaning: POP/LINE/HIGH VALUE: seat damage protection; PRO: footrests

setvars.name: sv_ac_service
setvars.meaning: A/C lock; always on for PRO

setvars.name: sv_passenger_panel_req
setvars.values: list (values per phase and floor type in picture tables)
setvars.meaning: passenger-area panels; options depend on phase and floor design (two groups: POP13/POP12/LINE13 double rear door/HV13 versus LINE13 single rear door, LINE12, HV12, PRO, 10 m)

setvars.name: sv_curtains_req
setvars.meaning: POP: 1 curtains on; LINE/HV/PRO: 0 curtains on, 1 off

setvars.name: sv_stopreq_driver_req
setvars.meaning: driver-side stop button; not possible in phase 2

setvars.name: sv_wheels_req
setvars.meaning: wheel design; styles 1,3,4 recolourable in texture; sub-option 0b via nut covers

setvars.name: sv_middle_door_req
setvars.meaning: 0 asymmetric, 1 symmetric double middle door; double-door versions only

setvars.name: sv_windows
setvars.meaning: 0 all windows open, 1 five openable, 2 none; PRO fixed 2

setvars.name: sv_mirrors_cover
setvars.meaning: mirror type 1/2 combined with reflective or matt; LINE/HV/PRO only

setvars.name: sv_cockpit_clock
setvars.meaning: clock variant: 0 off, 1 clock with stop indicator, 2 stop lamp

setvars.name: sv_doors_toplights_c
setvars.meaning: door top lights, decoration only; PRO/CNG

setvars.name: sv_school_sign
setvars.meaning: school boards; POP/LINE 0 = on, HV/PRO 1 = on

setvars.name: sv_cng_right_cover
setvars.meaning: 0 roof panel right on, 1 off; CNG

setvars.name: sv_dash_doors_sw_pos
setvars.meaning: door buttons right/left of dashboard; phase 1 only

setvars.name: sv_dash_brakevalve_sw
setvars.meaning: brake valve: POP/LINE 1 = on; HV/PRO 0 = on

setvars.name: sv_dash_automatic_sw_pos
setvars.meaning: automatic gearbox buttons right/left; fixed left on POP 13M and all 10 m

setvars.name: engine_sv_req
setvars.meaning: engine: Tector 7 320, Cursor 9 360, Cursor 9 400 (POP T7=0,C9=1; LINE T7=1,C9=0; HV T7=1,C9=0,C9-400=2; PRO C9=0,C9-400=1); diesel only; restart

setvars.name: gearbox_sv_req
setvars.meaning: gearbox: POP/LINE EcoShift=0, DIWA=1, Ecolife=2; HV/PRO/CNG DIWA=0, Ecolife=1, EcoShift=2; restart

setvars.name: sv_display_front
setvars.meaning: front display model; 3 gives a terminal note

setvars.name: sv_carpets
setvars.meaning: floor mats; LINE: none/driver space; CITY: none/front/+driver space/+complete (table order unclear)

setvars.name: sv_driver_hood_req
setvars.meaning: driver box: 0 classic, 1 CITY, 2 none (CITY only); 1 moves display controller; fixed on ACTIA dash

setvars.name: sv_seats_acd_req
setvars.meaning: 0 seat arm set on, 1 off; CITY only

setvars.name: sv_door_plastic_req
setvars.meaning: plastic on top of doors; LINE

setvars.name: sv_doors_toplights_c
setvars.meaning: door top lights; LINE; needs sv_door_plastic_req

setvars.name: sv_cng_left_cover
setvars.meaning: 0 left roof panel on, 1 off; CNG

setvars.name: sv_cng_right_cover
setvars.meaning: 0 right roof panel on, 1 off; CNG

setvars.name: sv_bus_phase
setvars.meaning: switch stickers/sounds/colours/dash units to phase style; diesel only, not on some phase 2

setvars.name: sv_driver_cockpit_req
setvars.meaning: driver cab type; IVECO dash only

setvars.name: sv_dash_gong
setvars.meaning: gong; IVECO dash 1 = on, ACTIA dash inverted (0 = on)

setvars.name: sv_dash_cruiselimiter
setvars.meaning: 0 cruise/limiter active, 1 off; IVECO BUS versions

setvars.name: engine_sv_req
setvars.meaning: LINE: Cursor 9 360=0, Tector 7 320=1; CITY: Cursor 9=0, Tector 320=1, Tector 285=2; diesel only, not 15 m

setvars.name: gearbox_sv_req
setvars.meaning: IVECO dash: DIWA 0, manual 6 =1, Ecolife 2; ACTIA dash: DIWA 0, Ecolife 1, no manual

setvars.name: gearbox_achse_req
setvars.meaning: axle ratio, manual 6-speed only: Cursor 3.07/3.36/4.63 and Tector 4.63/5.29/5.63; LINE value 0 = lowest ratio listed, 1 next; CITY 2/0/1 for the three ratios (from the table order). Speed limits 85 km/h CITY, 100 km/h LINE

setvars.name: sv_gearbox_lock_std
setvars.meaning: start only in first gear on manual; needs gearbox_sv_req manual; IVECO dash

setvars.name: sv_disable_plate
setvars.meaning: 0 automatic French plate, 1 off (plate then from repaint)

setvars.name: system_language_req
setvars.meaning: start language: 0 French, 1 Czech, 2 German, 3 English

setvars.name: doors_beep_disable_req
setvars.meaning: door-open alarm; this doc labels 0 as deactivated, 1 activated, which contradicts the name (compare Irisbus doc: 1 = deactivated)

setvars.name: sv_carpets
setvars.meaning: floor mats (Urban: none, front, +rear stamper, +driver space, +complete; SubUrban: none, driver space; assignment of tables to values is as in doc layout)

setvars.name: sv_logos_norm_req
setvars.meaning: emission label: 0 Euro 5, 1 Euro 4, 2 EEV, 3 none

setvars.name: sv_engine_hood
setvars.meaning: engine cover style 0 centered plate, 1 left plate; needs matching repaint texture

setvars.name: sv_driver_hood_req
setvars.meaning: driver box: 0 classic, 1 Urban, 2 none (Urban only)

setvars.name: sv_driver_cockpit_req
setvars.meaning: driver cab type; Urban options 3 and 4 replaced by 0 if sv_driver_hood_req=1

setvars.name: sv_driver_handle_req
setvars.meaning: driver cab handle; SubUrban only with cockpit 0 or 2, Urban with 3 or 4; needs sv_stopreq_driver>2

setvars.name: sv_shifter_style
setvars.meaning: 0 pneumatic assisted, 1 long; Tector with manual only

setvars.name: var_seats
setvars.meaning: seat model/layout, also moves grab poles and stop buttons: rounded Citybus=0, squared=1, B3000=2 (B3000 only on a few models, e.g. 0A3DG, 72D); 2 options on most, 3 on 7700 2D

setvars.name: var_plate
setvars.meaning: registration plate shape; 7700 and some articulated only

setvars.name: vis_enjo
setvars.meaning: hide/show hubcaps; picture tables give hubcaps = 0 on most models (1 on 7A3D) and standard wheels = 1 on most (0 on 73D), so the value is model dependent

setvars.name: var_ac_front
setvars.meaning: front roof A/C unit present (1) or not (0)

setvars.name: var_ac_mid
setvars.meaning: middle roof A/C unit, standard (non-articulated) only

setvars.name: var_ac_rear
setvars.meaning: rear A/C unit shown by default; 10 = no rear A/C (other values only hide the model, cooling stays)

setvars.name: var_ac
setvars.meaning: A/C roof type for articulated (the 'var_ac_xx' family); same default/10 caveat as var_ac_rear

setvars.name: var_dash
setvars.meaning: dashboard: 7000: 0 old, 2 VDO (new unavailable); 7700: 0 new, 1 old, 2 VDO

setvars.name: ver_body
setvars.meaning: side mouldings (table calls it var_body); 7700 only

setvars.name: ver_px
setvars.meaning: door mechanism: 7000 ISAF=0, Webasto-Kiekert=1; 7700 ISAF=0, Ventura=1

setvars.name: var_rvm
setvars.meaning: mirror type: 0/1 streamlined variants swap per model, 2 basic, 3 streamlined single arm short

setvars.name: var_cockpit
setvars.meaning: cab look: 0 low driver door, 1 high driver door (swapped on 7000A CNG), 2 full cabin, 3 low door with anti-aggression glass (not on 7700 after 2004)

setvars.name: var_colav
setvars.meaning: hide dash grab handle; 1 forced when var_cockpit=2

setvars.name: var_CNG
setvars.meaning: reverses front part of CNG tank (SEMITAN)

setvars.name: vis_LCI
setvars.meaning: replace facelifted 7700 cockpit by pre-facelift 7000 cockpit; exclusive to 7700

setvars.name: door_setvar_beep
setvars.meaning: time delay and warning sound for rear door closing

setvars.name: Var_langue
setvars.meaning: language of dash panel and some signage

setvars.name: Var_dev
setvars.meaning: automatic door mode (separate 3.0 guide): 0 manual, 1 auto/manual with button, 2 French auto (DEV), 3 full auto; behaviour differs for modern and Actia dash

setvars.name: vis_CTI_Tuertaster_Auto
setvars.meaning: 0 show all door buttons, 1 only manually operable

setvars.name: vis_CTI_Tuersteuerung
setvars.meaning: which doors are manual/automatic/both; many combos

setvars.name: vis_CTI_Stadionschalter
setvars.meaning: 0 none, 1 style 1, 2 style 2 central door opener

setvars.name: vis_CTI_Fahrgastpendel
setvars.meaning: passenger barrier: 0 none, 1 single rear cab wall, 2 two, 3 on door separator bar (needs active bar)

setvars.name: vis_CTI_Tuerfluegelheizung
setvars.meaning: door leaf heating: 0 both, 1 front, 2 none

setvars.name: vis_CTI_trennscheiben
setvars.meaning: small/big door separators; external swing and swing/sliding doors only

setvars.name: vis_CTI_TuerV_piepen
setvars.meaning: door closing warning, front door: 0 none, 1 before, 2 during, 3 both

setvars.name: vis_CTI_Kennzeichen_Repaint
setvars.meaning: 0 plate from OMSI plate input, 1 from CTC texture

setvars.name: vis_CTI_Windschutzscheibe
setvars.meaning: rain sensor pre-series, series, with Mobileye

setvars.name: vis_CTI_Aussentuertaster
setvars.meaning: external door button beside door or on door leaf (swing doors only)

setvars.name: vis_cti_aussenkiwataster
setvars.meaning: external stroller button beside door or on leaf (lowercase prefix in doc)

setvars.name: vis_CTI_doortype_v
setvars.meaning: front door type: 0 pneumatic interior swing, 1 external swing, 2 external swing-sliding, 3 electric interior swing

setvars.name: vis_CTI_doortype_h2
setvars.meaning: second rear door type, same coding

setvars.name: vis_CTI_Matrix_LED_Polycolor
setvars.meaning: single/multi colour destination display; needs adapted hof file else white

setvars.name: vis_CTI_Matrix
setvars.meaning: wide rear destination or small rear line display

setvars.name: vis_CTI_Matrix_Fahrerseite
setvars.meaning: driver side matrix off/small line/wide destination

setvars.name: vis_CTI_Rad_V
setvars.meaning: wheel front axle: 0 rim, 1-3 hubcap type, 4 rim type 2 (front axle only)

setvars.name: svr_light_setcolor
setvars.meaning: interior light colour: 0 off, 1 green, 2 red, 3 blue, 4 orange

setvars.name: svr_seat
setvars.meaning: seat model: 0 Compin SB09, 1 Compin Perseus, 2 Ster 8MS

setvars.name: svr_airconditionning
setvars.meaning: 0 none, 1 A/C, 2 driver A/C, 3 powered ventilation, 4 driver A/C + ventilation

setvars.name: svr_door_2_self_enabled
setvars.meaning: self-service door: 0 off, 1 interior and exterior, 2 interior only, 3 interior active with exterior shutters (as tabulated)

setvars.name: svr_door_2_wreq_enabled
setvars.meaning: door 2 ramp request button: 0 off, 1 outside active / shutter inside (as tabulated)

setvars.name: svr_door_3_self_enabled
setvars.meaning: same as door 2 self (value coding stated for doors 3 and 4)

setvars.name: svr_self_mode
setvars.meaning: normal or alternative automatic door management

setvars.name: svr_advert_back
setvars.meaning: 0 off, 1 frame only, 2 frame and ad

setvars.name: svr_advert_left_1
setvars.meaning: front left flank advert, same coding; 18M

setvars.name: svr_auto_mode
setvars.meaning: setvar management by park number (automatic assignment)

setvars.name: svr_tank_extension
setvars.meaning: larger gas tank (no value row given)

setvars.name: svr_mirrors
setvars.meaning: 0 default, 2 camera rear view (value 1 not shown)

setvars.name: ver_sol
setvars.meaning: floor plan; each is compatible only with some ver_sieges: floor 0 with seats 0 and 2, floor 1 with seats 01, floor 2 with seats 011

setvars.name: ver_sieges
setvars.meaning: seat layout/fabric; codes 0, 01, 011, 2 (2+2 Euro2), 0 and 01 (2+2 Euro3), 2 options on 1+2 Euro3 (solid or fabric backs)

setvars.name: vis_enjo
setvars.meaning: wheel cover option; default OFF except S315NF 1+2+1 Euro3 (ON); the description page calls it vis_enjol

setvars.name: ver_plaques
setvars.meaning: small front plate (Switzerland, Italy) versus normal size plate

setvars.name: ver_logos
setvars.meaning: old logo design on Euro3; needs the official logos mod from OMSI webdisk

setvars.name: ver_clim
setvars.meaning: 1 big A/C unit; default ON on 1+2 variants, OFF on 2+2

setvars.name: ver_body
setvars.meaning: cooling style: 0 extended cooling (default 2+2), 1 standard (default 1+2); change with ver_body=1

setvars.name: vis_pub
setvars.meaning: advertising panels; rear plate becomes small square

setvars.name: ver_retro
setvars.meaning: 0 light mirrors, 1 reinforced mirrors (+ right mirror)
